basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software developer based in Toronto, Canada. I love gaming, especially mobile and indie games. My interest in technology and gaming began in my teenage years, and I've been actively engaged in the gaming community ever since. Apart from gaming, I'm passionate about cooking and have recently developed an interest in parenting and family life as my partner and I are expecting our first child. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings and weekends. In addition to gaming, I work remotely as a full-stack developer for a tech startup. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner of 5 years.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience working in the tech industry, I have a solid understanding of programming and software development. I also keep myself updated on gaming trends and technologies through online courses, tutorials, and community forums.
